metric_definitions.detection_delay_ms: Fault injection timestamp to controller first anomaly detection. No-repair has no controller timestamp.
metric_definitions.retained_failed_observation_delay_upper_: No-repair only: fault to earliest timestamp in the retained failed observation; an upper bound for first detection.
metric_definitions.fault_to_first_resumed_progress_ms: Fault to completion of the first resumed training step (step 6) by BOTH ranks.
metric_definitions.observed_failure_to_resumed_progress_ms: Independent worker exit timestamp to both ranks first resumed step; distinct origin from injection.
metric_definitions.fault_to_progress_beyond_prefault_ms: Fault to both ranks completing step 8, surpassing pre-fault step 7.
metric_definitions.fault_to_final_training_completed_ms: Fault to latest completed_at across final ranks after final checkpoint (step 20).
metric_definitions.fault_to_controller_terminal_ms: Fault to controller terminal after launcher exit and verification; not first resumed progress.
metric_definitions.rollback_steps: Last common reported step 7 minus committed recovery step 5.
metric_definitions.training_timing: Wall train_step_ms includes input, forward/backward, optimizer and CUDA sync. Excludes explicit post-step barrier, checkpoint I/O, fault gate, restart, and fixed 50 ms pause. Use max over ranks per logical step; discard first 5 samples per epoch for descriptive steady estimates. Single trial only.
